adaptation: Package namespaces, standalone input checks, and extension entry points. Device arithmetic and launch choices retained.

compiler_prior.license_note: No license file present in the source revision. Local compiler seed retained for this user-requested translation; CUDA implementation written independently from the operator equations and execution strategy.

stream_mix.implementation: Independent CUDA C++ implementation of the projected mixing equations. v3 row/D tiling is the initial compiler prior; master defines decay, mixed dtypes and caller composition. Subsequent measured optimization uses vectorized forward loads, fused input gradients, and shared G*X^T parameter contractions: CUTLASS SIMT for FP32 and WMMA for already-stored FP16/BF16 operands with FP32 accumulation. Existing FP32 coefficients/intermediates are never reduced to TF32. No model implementation is copied into runtime code.

expm_stream_mix.semantic_authority: stream_mix.semantic_authority; continuous-hc master CGHC, m=1, one-sided projection with impulse forcing
expm_stream_mix.implementation: N4 CUDA forward reuses MatrixExpSmall.cuh adaptive t18, then shared-memory Phi and register-local rank-one source. Preserves explicit transition and source operand/result casts. Supplied mean/V direction; A already contains dt. No integral computation, model copy, or new backward kernel. Gradient-enabled calls use existing unfused operators.
